episode_summary: In this episode, Sarah Maslowski shares her insights on the critical role of titles and thumbnails in YouTube success. She discusses common mistakes agents make and offers practical strategies, including using AI tools and outsourcing design work, to enhance video marketing effectiveness. Her advice is geared towards helping agents attract more views and engagement on their content.
